geopolitics_summary: EU climate policy intensifies amid summer extremes; Norway pushes Arctic drilling; Iran sanctions tighten; Romania reports hybrid warfare at gas platform.

themes.headline: Romanian offshore gas platform targeted by drone; Moscow blamed hybrid warfare
themes.why_it_matters: Direct threat to Black Sea gas production (Romania key supplier). Platform disruption cuts gas flow into EU, tightens supply, raises TTF and power margins via fuel scarcity.

themes.headline: Danube drought escalates; EU lacks contingency for river-dependent hydropower, cooling
themes.why_it_matters: Danube drying constrains nuclear plant cooling and hydroelectric output across Central/Eastern Europe. Reduces power supply elasticity; forces fuel switching to gas or coal, lifting Cal+1 and power spreads.

themes.headline: France budget crunch from heat wave; rethinking climate and energy investment plans
themes.why_it_matters: France fiscal constraints may slow nuclear reinvestment or renewable buildout. Weaker capex in EU's largest baseload producer could ease longer-term power supply but near-term policy uncertainty risks subsidy delays.

themes.headline: Bessent announces fresh sanctions on Iran; war enters sixth month
themes.why_it_matters: Tighter Iran sanctions reduce LNG supply from non-OPEC peers; redirects global LNG flows. Indirect TTF pressure via reduced spot LNG availability to Europe, especially if US LNG exports rise into gap.

themes.headline: Libya ramps fossil fuel output to fill energy void left by Hormuz instability
themes.why_it_matters: Increased Libyan crude exports ease global oil supply; lower Brent pressure reduces fuel-oil power generation cost in Europe. Marginal bearish-power effect via lower generation spreads, but political instability creates execution risk.

watchlist: Von der Leyen State of the Union speech — climate & AI focus; watch for EU ETS, carbon tariff signaling.
Industrial Accelerator Act finalization — France–Germany divergence on clean industry subsidy & carbon rules.
Norway Arctic drilling approval — EU energy security vs. climate tensions; LNG/gas policy implications.
Danube water levels & nuclear/hydro output forecasts — risk trigger for Central European power tightness.
